name: Bridge Impact AI
description: AI驱动的原住民和解实践平台，为组织和个人提供可衡量的和解行动工具，资助青年主导的社区项目，并提供原住民文化历史学习资源；其AI咨询功能基于原住民知识数据集训练
description_en: AI-driven platform offering tools for organizations and individuals to measure and implement Indigenous reconciliation practices, fund youth-led community projects, and learn about Indigenous culture and history; AI trained on Indigenous knowledge datasets

latest_news: 2026年9月在维多利亚科技周软启动beta版应用，目前正在申请非营利组织身份，并寻求组织合作伙伴共同开发技术；计划2027年春季扩展至澳大利亚
latest_news_en: Soft-launched beta app at Victoria Tech Week in September 2026; currently applying for non-profit status and seeking organizational partners to co-develop tech; planning expansion to Australia in spring 2027
source_title: With launch of new app, BC startup Bridge looks to digitize reconciliation

evidence.quote: The intention behind this is to build a data set that is built from the Indigenous worldview, based on Indigenous knowledge … because the majority of AI, like Claude or Gemini, they pull from colonial data sets that have bias built in

name: スマートエイト
description: 法人向けAI活用支援を提供する企業。ChatGPTやClaudeなどのツール導入だけでなく、業務課題の整理から研修、コンサルティング、開発まで一気通貫で支援。経営者向けマンツーマン伴走支援やClaude Code環境構築、Web広告代理店向けSaaS「Smart Ad Report」も提供。
description_en: Corporate AI adoption consulting firm providing end-to-end support from identifying business challenges to training, consulting, and development. Services include one-on-one executive coaching, Claude Code environment setup, and Smart Ad Report SaaS for web advertising agencies.
why_matters: 既存SaaSでは対応できない業務特有のニッチな課題をAIで仕組み化できる点が差別化要因。生成AIによって自社専用の小規模アプリや業務ツールを短期間で開発可能にし、定型業務削減を実現。代表は大手教育・人材企業で事業開発を経験し、自社でもAIを使い倒して成果を出す実践力を持つ。
why_matters_en: Differentiates by automating niche business-specific tasks that existing SaaS cannot handle. Uses generative AI to build custom small-scale apps and tools quickly, reducing routine work. CEO has business development experience at major education and HR firms and demonstrates strong practical AI implementation capabilities within the company.
latest_news: 2025年3月に株式会社スマートエイトを設立。現在、広告代理店・商社・製造業・医療法人など幅広い業界に向けてAI活用・業務自動化支援を展開中。
latest_news_en: Founded SmartEight Inc. in March 2025. Currently providing AI adoption and business automation support to diverse industries including advertising agencies, trading companies, manufacturing, and medical corporations.
source_title: 【#765】AIで定型業務を減らし、人間が「価値創造」に集中できる社会へ - ベンチャー.jp

evidence.quote: 早稲田大学卒業後、ベネッセコーポレーションで教育事業の企画に6年間従事。リクルートでは事業開発組織のゼネラルマネージャーを担当。2025年3月に株式会社スマートエイトを設立

name: Mighto AI
description: 为不动产管理公司和HOA提供AI调达服务，AI代理可同时向最多18家供应商进行电话、短信联系，完成报价获取、跟进和价格谈判，将采购时间缩短至十分之一

name: Ubie

Awarded Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Prize in September 2026 for contributions to appropriate medical consultation and hospital efficiency, and led the development of healthcare AI safety evaluation guidelines to establish industry standards
latest_news: 2026年9月25日在日本スタートアップ大賞2026颁奖典礼获得厚生劳动大臣赏(医疗・福祉スタートアップ赏),表彰其将生活者向けAI与医疗机构向け生成AI结合推进适切受診行動支援和医疗现场业务效率化
latest_news_en: Received the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare Prize (Healthcare and Welfare Startup Award) at the Japan Startup Awards 2026 ceremony on September 25, 2026, recognized for combining consumer-facing AI with generative AI for medical institutions to advance appropriate consultation behavior and healthcare operational efficiency
